strict_scale_note: Rebuilt as a regional JetStream continuity work package under large_system_strict.

root_cause_clusters.RC1_PUBLISH: Publish path mints unstable message ids and marks the journal published before a matching origin ACK.
root_cause_clusters.RC2_GENERATION: Origin observations auto-approve fingerprint changes and treat sequence regression as the same generation.
root_cause_clusters.RC3_CONSUMER: Consumer processing ACKs and checkpoints before durable effects; poison is treated as progress; health ignores gaps.
root_cause_clusters.RC4_RECONCILE: Reconciliation compares counts and hub aggregate sequence instead of stable event identity.
root_cause_clusters.RC5_REPLAY: Replay plans copy the full journal range, ignore overlap except exact equality, and allow unapproved generations.
root_cause_clusters.RC6_FENCE: Expired lease reacquire keeps the old epoch and replay execution ignores fence epoch.
root_cause_clusters.RC7_TOPOLOGY_RETENTION: Duplicate origin stream names, local hub listen subjects, short max-age, and archive-only cleanup watermarks.
